claim_boundary: Produce raw readings and uncertainty tables only. C6 remains unidentified with four arm-level independent units; C13 requires a separate training design.

shared.window_protocol: R4 window-v2: generation/text region only; window-token mean -> sample-window mean -> equal sample weight
shared.bootstrap: resample samples, never windows; paired indices within a fixed corpus across checkpoints

C2.metric: centered residual covariance normalized effective rank
C2.transient_test: per draw max over steps 5/10/20/40/80 of current-minus-base; report percentile CI and P(max>0)
C2.protocol_audit: R5_raw_er_fixed_ckpt.csv and R5_raw_er_fixed.csv remain separate; no direct numerical merge across generated-text and fixed-probe protocols

C3.layer_sensitivity_source: C14 per-checkpoint point-estimate table at L9/L18/L27
C3.S_bos_aggregation: equal mean over generation seeds 3,17,31; sample bootstrap within each seed

C5.text_region: prompt text itself, represented as a fixed E probe; no generated response
C5.factor_retention: disabled because the 541-row all-linear factor bundle would require multiple GiB per checkpoint

C8.score_scope: response tokens only conditioned on complete prompt
C8.warning: X_OPD is a deterministic step-0 reconstruction because the original online OPD training responses were not archived

C11.task: same frozen 1400-question MMLU-Pro subset as S1-8
C11.prompt: S1-8 doc_to_text followed by target delimiter single space
C11.answer_position: next token immediately after the terminal 'Answer: ' context
C11.primary_entropy: full-vocabulary Shannon entropy in nats from float32 log_softmax
secondary: probability mass on all available option first tokens
entropy renormalized over unique option first tokens
C11.option_count_audit: the frozen 1400-row S1-8 input contains 3-10 available options per question (not uniformly ten); use every valid option present in that row and record the distribution
C11.candidate_first_token_convention: from the explicitly tokenized terminal-space context state, encode each bare available option with add_special_tokens=false and use its first token ID; duplicate IDs are uniqued for mass and restricted entropy
C11.checkpoint_grid: base plus all nonzero checkpoints of all four arms
C11.no_substitute: sequence-level option LL and empirical response frequency are not token entropy

C14.inference: descriptive only; no causal or independent-probe claim

C15.cap_hit: finish == length OR response token length >= generation cap
C15.claim_rule: unpaired N=500 formal and N=60 pilot runs support aggregate description only; cap robustness requires a future paired rerun
